name: 承認の公開範囲案内
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse approval-visibility information strip LH09-0034. Original images1–2 control the actual lock silhouette, optical weight, spacing, alignment and structure. Mock3 is Japanese wording only: its club-like substitute symbol is WRONG and must be replaced by the original LOCK.
Compact wide strip666x54 logical pixels. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and banner surface, fine neutral top/bottom rules, no gray/mint fill. At x25 logical pixels, original small LOCK: solid slate #526173 rectangular body with subtly rounded corners and a short arched shackle, source-like optical size10–12px, no oversized outline, no club/heart/person/shield. Center vertically on the message.
At x45px show exact Japanese sentence「共同作業者と親の作業を閲覧できる人に表示されます。」in Meiryo Regular14/24, dark neutral, zero tracking. Natural compact wrapping into two lines only if needed; do not truncate or change meaning.
At right preserve original unboxed text action「公開する」, Regular14/24, brand green #1F6444, vertically centered, generous source-like separation from message and right inset about35px. This is one simple text action, no extra icon, button box or status badge.
Keep original compact readable banner hierarchy. All message text regular, no bold. No additional title, paragraph, controls, app shell, perspective, watermark, annotation or comparison grid. Crisp flat UI screenshot, very little outer whitespace.
reviewNotes: 全文の日本語、公開するのテキスト操作、原本の小さい塗り鍵の形を目視確認。白い案内面と通常ウェイト、意味を確認。外側余白、厳密なフォント／原本ピクセル同一性、実際の公開権限動作は未証明。静的画像のエージェントレビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
